# payments-testing

Install: `composer require --dev rasuvaeff/payments-testing`

Rules: namespace `Rasuvaeff\PaymentsTesting`; contracts come from
`rasuvaeff/payments` (`Rasuvaeff\Payments`). `FakePaymentGateway` implements
only the base `PaymentGatewayInterface`. Use `FakeCaptureGateway`,
`FakeConfirmGateway`, `FakeCancelGateway` or `FakeRefundGateway` when that
optional interface is required. Idempotency keys replay only identical request
fingerprints; a reused key with different data throws. Time is fixed via
`FakeGatewayConfig::$now` — never the wall clock. Assertions throw
`ContractViolationException` (extends `RuntimeException`) on violations and
work with any test framework.

## Fake gateways

```php
$config = new FakeGatewayConfig(
    provider: new PaymentProvider(value: 'fake'),          // default 'fake'
    capabilities: CapabilitySet::of(),                     // default empty
    now: new \DateTimeImmutable('2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'), // default shown
    createState: PaymentState::Succeeded,                  // default
);
$gateway = new FakePaymentGateway(config: $config);        // config optional
$attempt = $gateway->createPayment($createPaymentRequest); // PaymentAttempt
$attempt = $gateway->retrievePayment($retrievePaymentRequest);
$gateway->provider();      // PaymentProvider
$gateway->capabilities();  // CapabilitySet
```

- `FakeCaptureGateway::capturePayment(CapturePaymentRequest): PaymentAttempt`
- `FakeConfirmGateway::confirmPayment(PaymentOperationRequest): PaymentAttempt`
- `FakeCancelGateway::cancelPayment(PaymentOperationRequest): PaymentAttempt`
- `FakeRefundGateway::createRefund(CreateRefundRequest): RefundAttempt`,
  `retrieveRefund(RetrieveRefundRequest): RefundAttempt`
- `PartialRefundCapability` in config of a non-refund fake →
  `InvalidArgumentException`.

## Contract assertions

All static, all return the resulting attempt, all throw
`ContractViolationException` on contract violations. Capability-specific
methods require intersection types
(`PaymentGatewayInterface&CaptureGatewayInterface` etc.).

```php
PaymentGatewayAssertions::assertCapabilities(PaymentGatewayInterface $g): CapabilitySet;
PaymentGatewayAssertions::assertCreatePayment(PaymentGatewayInterface $g, CreatePaymentRequest $r): PaymentAttempt;
PaymentGatewayAssertions::assertCreatePaymentIdempotency(PaymentGatewayInterface $g, CreatePaymentRequest $r): PaymentAttempt; // needs idempotencyKey
PaymentGatewayAssertions::assertRetrievePayment(PaymentGatewayInterface $g, RetrievePaymentRequest $r): PaymentAttempt;

CaptureGatewayAssertions::assertCapturePayment(PaymentGatewayInterface&CaptureGatewayInterface $g, CapturePaymentRequest $r): PaymentAttempt;
ConfirmGatewayAssertions::assertConfirmPayment(PaymentGatewayInterface&ConfirmGatewayInterface $g, PaymentOperationRequest $r): PaymentAttempt;
CancelGatewayAssertions::assertCancelPayment(PaymentGatewayInterface&CancelGatewayInterface $g, PaymentOperationRequest $r): PaymentAttempt;

RefundGatewayAssertions::assertCreateRefund(PaymentGatewayInterface&RefundGatewayInterface $g, CreateRefundRequest $r): RefundAttempt;
RefundGatewayAssertions::assertCreateRefundIdempotency(PaymentGatewayInterface&RefundGatewayInterface $g, CreateRefundRequest $r): RefundAttempt; // needs idempotencyKey
RefundGatewayAssertions::assertRetrieveRefund(PaymentGatewayInterface&RefundGatewayInterface $g, RetrieveRefundRequest $r): RefundAttempt;
```

Checks performed: attempt/reference providers match `$g->provider()`;
operation id, payment/refund references and requested amounts are preserved;
idempotent replays return the same reference; `assertCapabilities` fails when
`PartialRefundCapability` is advertised without `RefundGatewayInterface`.
Idempotency asserts throw `InvalidArgumentException` when `idempotencyKey`
is null. `assertCreatePaymentIdempotency` probes all three halves of the
contract — same key returns the original payment, a different key
(`<key>-contract-other`) starts a new one, and the original key with
`amount + 1` must be refused — so a gateway that ignores the key cannot pass.
It therefore creates payments: run it against fakes or a sandbox.
